purpose: Prepare an explicit-slot, read-only Ampere voltage inventory before any later root-reviewed replay work.

arguments.--gpu: Required explicit PCI slot; no default GPU selection.
arguments.--out: Required new JSON path whose parent directory already exists; existing output is refused.

collector_behavior.root_discovery: Walks upward from the script until both AGENTS.md and src/druta are present; no local absolute repository path is embedded.
brackets: before and final bound Windows target
before and final complete VBIOS image bytes, length, and SHA-256
before and final managed display-driver registry snapshot
source commit, worktree status, and relevant source-file SHA-256 values before and after
collector_behavior.error_policy: Retain each reader's returned error or exception separately. Do not equate an unavailable or partial inventory with an empty inventory.
collector_behavior.preservation: Keep complete JSON-safe observations, including native/public hex blobs returned by the readers; retain the complete VBIOS image as hex.
collector_behavior.writes: Creates the requested local report; invokes no target registry or GPU configuration writer. Python/import and Git tooling may maintain their ordinary local caches.
collector_behavior.exit_status: A zero exit status means the local report was written. GPU/API capability, stability and errors must be assessed from the captured fields.

copy_paste_prompt: Continue the Druta work in this remote Codex task. First inspect AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, the current branch/commit, and the complete git status; preserve all existing local changes and do not reset, stash, checkout over, stage, or commit them. Review the supplied experiments/ampere_voltage_inventory_20261030.py and its called APIs before running it. Run ONLY its read-only inventory with an explicit PCI slot provided for this task and a new output path under an existing directory: python experiments/ampere_voltage_inventory_20261030.py --gpu <EXPLICIT_PCI_SLOT> --out <NEW_JSON_PATH>. Do not invoke setters, prepare/replay, registry writes, driver restarts, workloads, or process stops. Return the resulting artifact path and the recorded source commit/status, target identity, two read rounds, and any per-reader errors. Stop after this preflight; root must review the inventory before authorizing any mutation. Do not install tools, push, open a PR, or publish a release.
review_boundary: This handoff requests inventory only. It does not authorize voltage replay, setter calls, registry changes, restart, or any other mutation.
scope_notes: Read-only preflight has not been run on the remote adapter.
No NVIDIA App or tool installation, Windows reboot, workload, or new profile/Undo/recovery work is requested.
API absence and per-reader errors remain evidence, not authorization to try alternate commands.
